body: Found another solution - I'm using Vue, but should be doable across the board. 1. Use ais-stats to get number of pages ```vue ``` 2. As you run the function to generate the result text, you can decide to show the pagination ```js getResultText(nbHits, page, nbPages) { // Decide to show pagination if (nbPages > 1) eventBus.isShowingPagination = true // Return text let text = '' if (nbHits === 0) text = `W: No products found` if (nbHits === 1) text = `W: ${ nbHits } product found` if (nbHits > 1) text = `W: ${ nbHits } products found` if (nbPages > 1) text += ` - Page ${ page + 1 } of ${ nbPages }` return text } ``` 3. Now you can show/hide your pagination conditionally ```vue ``` Best of luck
